_crawl.linkedin_about: Costco Wholesale is a multibillion dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in 14 countries. We are the recognized leader in our field, dedicated to quality in every area of our business and respected for our outstanding business ethics. Despite our large size and rapid international expansion, we continue to provide an atmosphere in which our employees thrive and succeed. If you are an ambitious, energetic person who enjoys a fast-paced team environment filled with challenges and opportunities, you've come to the right place. Our successful employees are service-oriented with integrity and commitment toward a common goal of excellence. Costco offers great jobs, great pay, great benefits and a great place to work. Like us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/Costco Follow us on Pinterest: www.pinterest.com/Costco

Since 1993, we established ourselves in the produce industry by exporting wild mushrooms, cherries, kabocha, apples and citrus to Japan and Taiwan. relevant_companies.company_summary: Healthy Avocado is a seasoned importer of avocados with nearly 20 years of experience in the industry, fostering strong relationships with over 10 grower and packer families in Michoacán, Mexico. Since its inception in 1993, the company has expanded its expertise from exporting a variety of produce, including wild mushrooms and cherries, to successfully entering the avocado market in the United States. Committed to integrity and mutual benefit, Healthy Avocado focuses on understanding the supply chain, effective communication, and market analysis to ensure fair dealings with both suppliers and customers.

season nearly 52 weeks a year.

_crawl.about: Healthy Avocado is an importer of avocados with nearly 20 years in the avocado industry. We have developed and maintained excellent relations with over 10 growers/packer families in Uruapan, Tancitaro, Patzcuaro, Periban, Ario de Rosales, and Tacamburo. Since 1993, we established ourselves in the produce industry by exporting wild mushrooms, cherries, kabocha, apples and citrus to Japan and Taiwan. When Michoacan avocado producers were granted access to the USA market, we teamed up with the first packing houses as the market opened in Chicago, then Texas, and finally California in 2005. From our start until the present day, our Mission has been to: ***KNOW the supply side very well, from cultivation to harvest, packing, shipping and warehousing. ***COMMUNICATE what we learn, to form mutually beneficial and long lasting relationships. ***STUDY market information, to best predict market price movement. ***DEAL WITH INTEGRITY, giving our suppliers and customers what they fairly deserve.

The Avolio Process

## A Commitment to Quality and Purity
* Innovation Meets Tradition

At Avolio Industries, we specialize in producing premium avocado oil using sustainable methods. Our
commitment to quality and eco-conscious practices ensures that every product supports both health
and the environment.

Setting the standard for bulk organic and crude avocado oil. Our 8-tonne per hour production line
ensures efficiency while maintaining purity and quality, shipped globally in large tanks.

Avolio is an industry leader in the production and supply of 100% natural Ugandan avocado oil,
setting the standard for quality and sustainability in the sector. With a commitment to purity and
excellence, Avolio delivers avocado oil that is cold-pressed and unrefined, ensuring that every
bottle captures the full nutritional benefits and rich flavors of the Ugandan avocados used.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Dipasa Europe is a Mexican company which provides a wide range of high quality products with a reliable and flexible service. From our HACCP and BRC certified and temperature-controlled production facilities we provide a wide range of seeds throughout the European market and several countries abroad. In our plants in Enschede, the Netherlands, we have the possibility to clean, repack and toast bakery seeds, both conventional and organic. We also produce seed blends for bakery and retail applications. From our oil refinery in Mexico we produce sesame and avocado oils. We can provide our products in several packaging sizes, from big-bags to 1 kg. propylene bags and from 950 kg. IBC’s to 10 kg. cans. Dipasa Europe, part of the Dipasa Group with headquarters in Cortazar, Mexico, has been founded in 1990 and has since developed into a major and reliable supplier of high quality sesame seed and sesame seed products as well as other agricultural seeds worldwide. Dipasa is nowadays one of the world’s leading sesame seed producers and exporters. "Goodness is the only investment that never fails"

Eosta’s mission is to make the world more **Healthy, Fair & Organic** by driving positive change in
the food system. We do this together with a worldwide network of **over 1,000 **organic certified**
growers**, delivering organic and fair fresh produce with full transparency in the supply chain.

[More about us][72]

With growers across continents, we reduce regional risks and secure a stable supply.

### SUSTAINABLE LOGISTICS

Sustainable packaging & responsible transport is our expertise.

_crawl.about: Eosta is a leading international distributor of organic fresh fruits and vegetables, with Nature & More as it's leading "trace & tell"​ consumer trademark. Our ideal is to make the world healthier, fairer and more organic. We combine a unique range of year-round organic products with efficient logistics, quality assurance and product development, as well as innovative pre-packing facilities and ecological and social responsibility via the Nature & More "trace and tell"​ system. For Eosta, economy and ecology are indissolubly connected and underlie all commercial services to growers, consumers and those involved in the international organic sector. Nature & More originated last century as an additional quality assurance program of EOSTA. Eosta has been involved for many years to convince growers all over the world to change to organic or bio-dynamic practices and has assisted these growers with ecological advice to ensure their economic success. In response to consumer demand for healthy, organic and fairly traded food, Nature & More was created. The aim is to communicate the commitment and effort that individual organic growers make towards the planet and its people. We believe that the market is changed by every purchasing decision. We want to provide you with the necessary information so you can make an educated purchasing decision, because we believe that “a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world. Indeed, it's the only thing that ever has"​. (Margaret Mead)

# Golden Circle 

Your Strategic Partner in Olive Oil, Avocado Oil & Gourmet Products Trade

[Let's Talk][5]

## About Golden Circle 

Golden Circle is an international food trading and brokerage firm specializing in olive oil, avocado
oil, edible oils, and gourmet products. We connect premium producers from Spain, Italy, Turkey,
Tunisia, Chile, Peru, Kenya, and Tanzania with importers, distributors, and retail chains across
Europe, the Americas, and beyond.
 

Whether you need bulk supply, private label solutions, or branded products, we tailor every
operation to your market, your specs, and your margins. With first-hand industry knowledge and a
network built at ANUGA, SIAL, Gulfood, and the World Olive Oil Exhibition, we help buyers anticipate
where the market is heading and move first on high-growth categories like avocado oil.

[Learn More][6]
[Image by Lucio Patone]

## Our Services

What We Offer

Golden Circle provides a comprehensive range of services to facilitate international trade. Our
offerings include tailored solutions for local and global transportation, freight forwarding,
warehousing, and storage, ensuring a seamless and reliable supply chain.

### Export Trading & Brokerage

We connect producers with qualified international buyers, managing the full commercial cycle: from
sourcing and negotiation to samples, pricing, and deal execution. Our focus is on protecting margins
and building sustainable trade flows.

### Buyer & Importer Identification

We identify and qualify the right buyers for your product and target market - importers,
distributors, retail chains, and HORECA operators. Every connection is vetted for commercial fit,
compliance, and long-term potential.

### Market Entry & Development

Expanding into a new market or a new category? We provide structured go-to-market strategies backed
by local insights, competitive analysis, and pricing intelligence. We help you spot emerging
opportunities - like avocado oil - and enter as a pioneer, not a follower. From Europe to the
Americas to East Africa, we help you grow with confidence.

### Long-Term Partnerships

We don't do one-off transactions. Every relationship we build is designed to scale. We work
alongside our clients as their international trade partner, adapting to market shifts and unlocking
new opportunities together.

## About Golden Circle 

Golden Circle is an international food trading and brokerage firm specializing in olive oil, avocado
oil, edible oils, and gourmet products. We connect premium producers from Spain, Italy, Turkey,
Tunisia, Chile, Peru, Kenya, and Tanzania with importers, distributors, and retail chains across
Europe, the Americas, and beyond.
 

Whether you need bulk supply, private label solutions, or branded products, we tailor every
operation to your market, your specs, and your margins. With first-hand industry knowledge and a
network built at ANUGA, SIAL, Gulfood, and the World Olive Oil Exhibition, we help buyers anticipate
where the market is heading and move first on high-growth categories like avocado oil.

## Our Services

What We Offer

Golden Circle provides a comprehensive range of services to facilitate international trade. Our
offerings include tailored solutions for local and global transportation, freight forwarding,
warehousing, and storage, ensuring a seamless and reliable supply chain.

### Export Trading & Brokerage

We connect producers with qualified international buyers, managing the full commercial cycle: from
sourcing and negotiation to samples, pricing, and deal execution. Our focus is on protecting margins
and building sustainable trade flows.

### Buyer & Importer Identification

We identify and qualify the right buyers for your product and target market - importers,
distributors, retail chains, and HORECA operators. Every connection is vetted for commercial fit,
compliance, and long-term potential.

### Market Entry & Development

Expanding into a new market or a new category? We provide structured go-to-market strategies backed
by local insights, competitive analysis, and pricing intelligence. We help you spot emerging
opportunities - like avocado oil - and enter as a pioneer, not a follower. From Europe to the
Americas to East Africa, we help you grow with confidence.

### Long-Term Partnerships

We don't do one-off transactions. Every relationship we build is designed to scale. We work
alongside our clients as their international trade partner, adapting to market shifts and unlocking
new opportunities together.

# Health Benefits

### IT’S GOOD FOR YOU

The amazing avocado has many distinctive health benefits and is classed as a superfood by many. On
top of the many health benefits here are a few: It may reduce cholesterol, improve heart health and
lower blood pressure. It’s high in rich Oleic Acid, a very healthy fat. The essential fats found
avocados are essential for digestion and nutrient absorption because they nourish the lining of the
gut. It’s an all-round super food!

### IT HAS A HIGH SMOKE POINT

Not every oil is created equal. The benefit of avocado oil is that it can be heated to very high
temperatures. Why is this good? When oil is heated past its smoke point, the fat starts to break
down, releasing free radicals and any health benefit that the oil had is lost.

### EXTRA VIRGIN COLD PRESSED

Extra Virgin is the highest grade of avocado oil, produced from the pressing of good quality
avocados. Produced at low temperatures, without chemicals the oil is 100% pure and natural. Cold
pressing from the first press of the avocado fruit means retains the same high level of nutrients,
natural flavour, aroma and colour found in fresh avocado.

### 16 AVOCADOS IN EVERY BOTTLE

Every one of our 250ml bottles contains 16 cold pressed avocados. Quality Avocado Oil should have a
taste and colour characteristics of the fresh avocado fruit and be a dark vibrant green. We house
our oil in dark glass bottles, which keeps out light and oxygen retaining the quality of the oil

_crawl.about: The peak of fresh produce We are Hillfresh. We stand out in the import and export of fruit and vegetables. Thanks to our top-level operation, we are and always have been a valued and reliable partner for our customers and growers for years. And there’s more. Customers and growers appreciate our social and direct service. We’re friendly and professional. Tough, but fair. We are like a warm handshake with a firm grip. This is how we build relationships and invest in our customers and growers. To us, quality is about reliability, a strong organization and operation, and effective and clear communication with our partners. It’s about high-quality fresh fruit and vegetables, delivered correctly on time. It’s being a trustworthy partner for the long term. For us, quality is the condition to reach the level that we act on; the peak of fresh produce. Hillfresh The peak of fresh produce

**About Us**

## At Leonardi Laboratories, we pride ourselves on our unique approach to crafting high-quality
## aromatherapy products. What sets us apart is our unwavering dedication to excellence and our
## commitment to customer satisfaction.

As a family-owned business led by Joe Leonardi, who brings over three decades of industry
experience, we infuse our passion and expertise into every aspect of our operation. Since our
inception in 2003, we have been driven by a genuine love for our craft and a desire to share the
benefits of aromatherapy with the world.

One aspect that distinguishes us is our extensive clientele base, which includes hotels, resorts,
massage therapists, wholesalers, and individuals seeking premium aromatherapy products. Whether it’s
supplying in bulk to businesses or catering to individual needs, we strive to meet and exceed the
expectations of every customer.

What truly sets us apart is our meticulous sourcing process. We scour the globe for the finest
botanicals, sourcing from Australia and beyond to ensure that only the highest quality ingredients
make their way into our products. From essential oils to carrier oils and base oils, each ingredient
is carefully selected and bottled with precision at our laboratory in Sydney.

Moreover, our dedication to innovation is evident in our in-house research and development efforts.
We continuously explore new formulations and techniques to enhance the efficacy and appeal of our
products. By collaborating closely with our clients, we tailor solutions to meet their specific
needs, ensuring that every product we offer is crafted with care and expertise.

At Leonardi Laboratories, we don’t just sell products; we cultivate experiences. We invite you to
explore our range of aromatherapy essentials and discover the difference that passion, quality, and
expertise can make in your wellness journey.

# 

# ABOUT US


**Our Mission**
We are a Mexican company dedicated to the production, transformation, commercialization and export
of avocado and derivatives at a global level, through the sustainability of our processes and
through an organizational ethic based on collaborative work with its stakeholders.
**Our Vision**
Being one of the best Mexican companies in the avocado and derivatives industry, recognized for the
quality of our products, for our commitment to the environment, for the development of our
collaborators and our operational excellence.
**Our Commitment**
We are committed to socially responsible management as part of our business strategy, having a
positive impact on the quality of life of our employees, the community that surrounds us and the
environment.
**The Future**
At MEVI Avocados we approach the future with passion and confidence, with an enduring belief in the
promise of avocado, a superfood that promotes the health and well-being of our consumers.

MEVI's foundation lies in 5 CORE VALUES:
**TRUST** We make sure that everyone involved with our company works with the same high purpose and
ethics, driving significant positive outcomes for our company and industry.
**RESPONSABILITY** We are committed to supplying exclusively healthy products, like the avocado and
its derivatives.
**HONESTY** We combine professionalism with integrity in all aspects of our business, including team
members and suppliers.
**RESPECT** We recognize the capabilities and achievements of clients, team members and suppliers.
**CUSTOMER SERVICE** We offer excellent personalized attention and responsiveness from the moment of
purchase until the delivery of our products, with the aim of fulfilling and exceeding the
expectations of our customers.

**ADVANTAGES OF OUR SERVICE**
Experience: Overall knowledge of production and management of avocados since 1974. Market experience
as a packer since 1994, and as an exporter―through APEAM―since 2003. Balanced Value Chain Method:
MEVI pledges to provide the best service through this process, ensuring full control from planting
the avocado, to its storage and distribution.

**TIMELINE**


[Timeline]

**Cold Storage:** MEVI owns Crosspoint, Inc.a South Texas cold storage facility with a 60 container
capacity that serves as a primary distribution point.

# Welcome to N. Pardhan Vegetable & Fruit Powder Export Private Limited

global standards of purity and taste. We make products that are absolutely pure and do not contain
any additives, preservatives, or artificial flavours. Our entire pack is the true representation of

and recipe requirements, from the sweetness of apple and papaya to the earthy and tasty side of
spinach and tomato. The high-tech way of processing and packaging the powders ensures that the

ethical sourcing, and quality at every stage. As trustworthy** Vegetable Powders Exporters in

stimulate the sectors of beverages, bakery, baby food, nutraceuticals, and culinary applications.

## Welcome to So African Natural Oils

Since 2007, So African Natural Oils (SANO) has been at the forefront of the vegetable and seed oil
industry, proudly supplying the global food and cosmetics markets with the highest quality
cold-pressed natural oils.

Today, we export to over 12 countries worldwide and stand as South Africa’s largest exporter of
grape seed oil, while also offering premium avocado oil and macadamia oil in 24 ton bulk flexitanks.
Alongside these, our portfolio extends to a wide range of exotic cosmetic seed oils, tailored to
meet the needs of international partners.


## Who We Are

SANO is more than a supplier – we are a network of growers, harvesters, and processors, representing
the country’s largest cooperative of local seed oil farmers.

We are committed to sustainability, responsibility, and community empowerment. Our partnerships with
municipalities, NGOs, and rural cooperatives create opportunities for impoverished communities by
purchasing wild-harvested seeds and fruits – transforming local resources into global value.


## Our Commitment

At SANO, we believe that natural oils should benefit people and planet alike. We take pride in
delivering bulk oils of uncompromising quality to the international Food and Cosmetics Industries,
while operating in a way that respects the environment, supports our employees, and uplifts our
suppliers.

 

[[Screenshot 2025-08-21 at 05.35.51.png]][9]

## Sustainability through Innovation

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. From empowering rural communities through
wild-harvested seeds to ensuring responsible processing across our facilities, we are dedicated to
operating in harmony with people and planet.


As part of this vision, we developed LOGGI Eco Fire Logs – an innovative by-product of our oil
pressing process. Made entirely from natural grape seed press-cake that would otherwise go to waste,
Loggi offers a cleaner, greener alternative to traditional firewood.

By transforming production residues into a valuable energy source, we close the loop in our
operations and proudly contribute to the circular economy – reducing waste, conserving forests, and
creating sustainable value at every step.

_crawl.linkedin_about: So African Natural Oils' (SANO) is a bulk supplier of quality Cold Pressed Natural Oils to the international Food & Cosmetics Industries. The company pays extra attention to operating in a sustainable and responsible manner with regard to the environment, its employees and its suppliers. The company has furthermore partnered up with municipalities, NGO's and rural based co-operatives, whereby they can benefit impoverished communities in rural areas by purchasing their wild harvested seeds and fruits. After numerous small scales production and pilot plants, consultation with existing seed oil manufacturers, rural organizations and customers, the company believes they have the best combination of cutting edge technology and sustainable solutions to offer the global market products of the highest quality. The company is passionate about the opportunity to create employment in rural areas, which are struggling socio-economically, and plans to do this in a responsible manner and has a long term commitment to managing its environment sustainably. SANO has invested in innovative green technology whereby they can capitalize on their green biomass by-product to power their operation, but more significantly they can reduce their carbon footprint on the environment. So African Natural Oils is a member of the Organic Trade Association and has its organic certification through Ecocert SA, and has NOP and EU certification.

Featured Story

## The Avocado Company
## *of Uganda*

Established in 2019 in Western Uganda, we were founded with a bold ambition: to build a complete,
sustainable avocado value chain — from a 100-acre nucleus farm in Hapuyo to the tables and bathroom
cabinets of the world.

Our nucleus farm serves as both a production centre and a living reference model, demonstrating best
practices that 1,000 partner outgrower farmers can learn from and replicate across Kyegegwa
District.

[ Read the Full Story  → ][8]
What We Stand For

## Three Pillars of *Everything We Do*

01
🌱
Organic Farming

Organic practices from seed to shelf, minimising our environmental footprint across the entire value
chain — from cultivation to cold-press production.

02
🫙
Cold Pressed Avoil™

Extra virgin, unrefined, cold pressed. Every bottle preserves the natural goodness, vivid colour,
and full nutritional profile of Uganda's finest Hass avocados.

03
🤝
Fair Trade

We bypass middlemen entirely to guarantee fair, transparent prices directly to our 1,000 partner
outgrower farmers — building genuine rural prosperity.

What We Produce

## From the Branch *to the Bottle*

[Premium Hass avocados hanging on the branch, ready for harvest]
For Export · Fresh Fruit
Fresh Hass Avocados

Export-grade Hass avocados grown organically on our nucleus farm and by our outgrower network —
harvested at peak ripeness for international markets.

[Avoil™ extra virgin avocado oil bottles lined up, cold pressed and unrefined, made in Uganda]
Domestic Market · Avoil™
Avoil™ Avocado Oil

Cold pressed, unrefined, 100% pure. 280 ml per bottle — for culinary and cosmetic use, with export
scale planned.

[Avocados growing on the tree at the Kyegegwa nucleus farm]

_crawl.about: Jagsfresh is an online food specialist offering an extensive range of premium products with unbeatable value so that you can always feel good about what you eat. We are here to elevate your grocery shopping experience. Our sourcing of fresh fruits, vegetables, juices & dairy is straight from the farms and direct to your door. We believe in curating and selling some of the finest and most innovative products at value and aim to use completely sustainable packaging and be completely carbon neutral. Our roots go way back to the year 1850, where our journey started with Fresh and dry produce like Apples and other hill fruits grown in the Valley of Kashmir but later also introduced commercial horticulture to the State of Himachal Pradesh (Known as Punjab at the time). Our founders Abhinav and Samyak Jaggi , both Alumni of Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University have actively expanded the sourcing strength of the business to many regions across India and the world. Our network is deep rooted with over 5000 farmers following hygienic and sustainable farming practices.

Water & Food

Agthia’s Water & Food business delivers scale, reliability, and category leadership across the
region. With 1.35 million m³ of bottled water capacity, a strong HOS platform, and a fleet of 288+
vehicles, we serve households and businesses daily. Our portfolio spans 75+ SKUs and includes market
leaders such as the UAE’s #1 Water, Arabic Coffee and Tomato Paste brands.

Snacks

Agthia’s Snacking business brings together leading regional brands across dates, coffee, chocolate,
and savory snacks. With an annual processing capacity of 256,500 tons, presence in 60+ export
markets, and a portfolio of 2,500+ SKUs across 3,500+ points of sale, the business supports over
20,000 farmers while delivering high-quality products to consumers worldwide.

by Egypt’s and Jordan’s #1 frozen protein brands. With annual capacity of 119,000 tons and a 95,000
sqm manufacturing facility, the business serves regional and export markets through a growing
distribution network.

Agri-Business

country’s #1 flour and #1 animal feed brands. With annual capacity of 950,000 tons, the ability to
unload 1,600 tons per hour, and a portfolio of 105+ SKUs and 100+ feed types, the business serves
customers nationwide.

**Who are we? **
Our commitment

Goals and objectives

**+** We are a young, multidisciplinary and multilingual proffesionals dedicated to intermediate at
international level on olive oil transactions with the best prices from producers from Spain,
Tunisia and Portugal.

**+** We put producers and buyers in contact, whether they are bottlers, refineries, distributors,
large businesses, etc. Also we control the logistics process of the sale transaction and organise
the complete documentary support of the load.

**+** Our company is always willing to provide all the necessary quality certifications for each
type of oil, as well as its indicative organoleptic assessment.

**+** We make sure that the entire buying-selling process is transparent, easy and safe for our
clients from the beginning to the end.

**OUR SERVICES**
**Points of connection with you**


**+** We put producers and buyers in contact at an international level.

**+** Logistical and administrative support throughout the commercial operation: we manage all the
necessary procedures and permits, ensuring that the merchandise leaves and arrives at its
destination on time and according to the terms of the established contract.

**+** Indicative organoleptic evaluation.

**+** Oil packaging with your brand in any foreign language. Format: in bulk, in barrels, in glass
or plastic bottles, cans.

**+** Kosher and Halal certified oils and many others.

**What products do we work with?**
Quality commitment.

* COLD PRESSED OLIVE OILS
  **Virgin Olive Oil in all its categories: Extra virgin, Virgin and Lampante.**
  These are oils obtained from the fruits of the olive tree by mechanical or other physical means in
  conditions that prevent any impact on the oil.
  Depending on the acidity level, they are divided into:
  1. **Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil** and **Extra Virgin Olive Oil**, with a maximum free acidity
     of 0.8%.
  2. **Virgin Olive Oil**, with a maximum free acidity of 2%.
  3. **Lampante**, with a free acidity above 2%, requires purification before use.
* OLIVE OILS
  Due to its characteristics, it is recommended for frying, as a suitable substitute for vegetable
  oils, or for preparing various dishes.
  1. **Refined olive oil** - it contains the typical amount of fatty acids for olive oils, refined
     (rectified) oil has no smell, color or taste, does not contain beneficial substances such as
     polyphenols, and can only be sold in large volumes.
  2. **Pomace - **Oil obtained with the help of a solvent from the dried remains of freshly pressed
     olives (oil cake). After industrial purification, it is mixed with cold or extra cold pressed
     edible oils in any proportion. By law, the acidity of oil cake oils cannot be higher than 1%.
* VEGETABLE OILS
  Organic extra virgin avocado oil and any other vegetable oil.
* SUNFLOWER OIL
  Refined and high oleic sunflower oil.
**OUR CLIENTS**
**Globally**

– We have a wide range of clients-buyers in all corners of the world: countries of the former USSR,
United Arab Emirates, China and EU countries such as France, Belgium and Italy. We work with
distribution companies, packaging companies and refineries at a national and international level.

– We have a relationship of trust with our oil producers in order to reach the best agreement as
dictated by the market. The oil we work with is produced in Spain as well as in Portugal and
Tunisia.

Our contacts
For any demands and inquiries contact us during business hours from 8:00 to 20:00 (CET) by WhatsApp
/ Phone or email.
We will be delighted to work with you!

[+34 644500905][16] / [+34 644-500-217][17]
**E-mail:** [info@oleumluxe.com][18]

_crawl.linkedin_about: Baldor is one of the largest importers and distributors of fresh produce and specialty foods in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions. We buy directly from domestic farmers and international growers and provide customers with a consistent supply of fresh foods, prepared however they need it. We supply a full range of foodservice clientele from white tablecloth restaurants, hotels, corporate feeders, upscale food markets, hospitals, school cafeterias, country clubs, in-flight caterers and everything in between. Baldor is now headed by Kevin's son, T.J. Murphy, C.E.O. and David McInerney, President. We continue to grow and spread our mission of quality you can trust, and service that delivers. In April 2006, Baldor Boston opened in Chelsea, Massachusetts. In April 2012, Baldor D.C. raised its flag in Jessup, Maryland, and then moved in 2024 to a double-sized warehouse in Latham, Maryland. Our large geographical reach makes us a reliable supporter in each local community we service by buying directly from local farms. Whether you are as far north as Freeport, Maine, as far west as Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, or as far south as Charlotte, North Carolina, Baldor can fulfill your everyday specialty food needs.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Baldor Specialty Foods is a leading importer and distributor of fresh produce and specialty foods, serving the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including upscale restaurants, hotels, corporate feeders, hospitals, and schools, by sourcing directly from domestic farmers and international growers to ensure a consistent supply of high-quality products. With a commitment to quality and service, Baldor continues to expand its operations, supporting local communities and fulfilling specialty food needs across a wide geographical area.

# Foodservice Experts & Wholesale Partner

New Zealand’s largest wholesale distributor, supplying the industry with food, beverages and kitchen
consumables.

[About Us][89]
[Contact Us][90]
[REGISTER NOW FOR OUR TRADE SHOWS][91]

## Who we are

We are wholesale distributors and foodservice experts. At our core is service, people, quality
ingredients and expertise. Our 24 branches nationwide allow us to operate fast, efficiently, and
with a local feel, to ensure we can meet the needs of our customers.  
 
Our aim is to be a long term partner to our customers, and support them, and their business, every
day. 

[Find out more][92]
[OurIngedients-Image-Block2-422x570.jpg]
[Our Ingredients ][93]

We understand that consistently, high quality ingredients are critical for businesses, so we work
closely with hundreds of suppliers and growers to deliver exactly that. 
 
From locally sourced meat cuts to everyday essentials, we have a comprehensive range designed to
suit every menu.

[AboutUs-Block3-592x534-OurService.jpg]
[Our Service ][94]

We pride ourselves on having the best service.

Our online ordering platform, Mybidfood, makes managing and making orders easy, we offer next day
delivery 6 days a week, and have strong, long term relationships with suppliers and growers that
ensure dependable, continuous supply.

[AboutUs-Block3-592x534-OurPeople.jpg]
[Our People ][95]

Our Bidfood NZ family, of over 2500 employees, genuinely care about our customers.

From night shift staff packing orders, to customer service who are on the end of the phone all day,
or sales reps who are a consultancy service to your business, they want to go above and beyond to
support and help.

# Foodservice Experts & Wholesale Partner

New Zealand’s largest wholesale distributor, supplying the industry with food, beverages and kitchen
consumables.

[About Us][89]
[Contact Us][90]
[REGISTER NOW FOR OUR TRADE SHOWS][91]

## Who we are

We are wholesale distributors and foodservice experts. At our core is service, people, quality
ingredients and expertise. Our 24 branches nationwide allow us to operate fast, efficiently, and
with a local feel, to ensure we can meet the needs of our customers.  
 
Our aim is to be a long term partner to our customers, and support them, and their business, every
day. 

[Find out more][92]
[OurIngedients-Image-Block2-422x570.jpg]
[Our Ingredients ][93]

We understand that consistently, high quality ingredients are critical for businesses, so we work
closely with hundreds of suppliers and growers to deliver exactly that. 
 
From locally sourced meat cuts to everyday essentials, we have a comprehensive range designed to
suit every menu.

[AboutUs-Block3-592x534-OurService.jpg]
[Our Service ][94]

We pride ourselves on having the best service.

Our online ordering platform, Mybidfood, makes managing and making orders easy, we offer next day
delivery 6 days a week, and have strong, long term relationships with suppliers and growers that
ensure dependable, continuous supply.

[AboutUs-Block3-592x534-OurPeople.jpg]
[Our People ][95]

Our Bidfood NZ family, of over 2500 employees, genuinely care about our customers.

From night shift staff packing orders, to customer service who are on the end of the phone all day,
or sales reps who are a consultancy service to your business, they want to go above and beyond to
support and help.

[AboutUs-Block3-592x534-OurExpertise.jpg]
[Our Expertise ][96]

We have, and partner with, specialised teams and resources that allow us to offer expert services to
customers.

Access to manufacturing and importing capabilities allow us to constantly innovate and create
tailored solutions. Our Exclusive Brand porftolio add value to menus, and we have dedicated category
specialists to support with menu development.

## Trusted by over 30,000+ chefs and businesses.

From large establishments to small businesses, from restaurants to schools, we proudly serve a wide
range of hospitality and foodservice customers.
 
Working with a huge range of businesses means that we understand their pressure points, and how we
can help.

Driving innovation, customer friendly solutions and service excellence


[Responsible procurement ][50]
* Our suppliers are specialists in their product, as well as ethical and sustainably minded, located
  as close to the source of the food as possible. We source both quality wholesale foods and a large
  range of catering equipment and non-food essentials.
* We are proud to say we take a sustainability-based approach to product sourcing, minimising the
  impact of our carbon footprint, whilst ensuring fair labour practices are at the forefront of all
  stages of our supply chain.
[Value-add processing ][51]
* Through listening to our customers, Bidfood has identified opportunities for value-add light
  processing and bespoke manufacture to make our customers' lives easier.
* Around the world we have our own purpose-built facilities offering additional value-add services,
  as directed by customer needs and market trends identified.
[Warehousing and distribution efficiencies ][52]
* We invest in depots and vehicles equipped with state-of-the-art efficient and sustainable
  capabilities. We utilise tools such as voice-pick technology and onboard-telematics in vehicles to
  ensure improved efficiencies and accuracies in service. Coupled with anti-error systems, we commit
  to reduced preparation error rates and overall improved working conditions for our workforce.
* Our fleet is equipped to simultaneously distribute products at positive and negative temperatures,
  with modular compartments equipping us to deliver to specific customer and product requirements.
[Market-leading innovation ][53]
* Our in-house developed ecommerce solution is a market-leading customer communication, transaction
  and information portal connecting us directly. Customers have online touch access to products
  offered by Bidfood divisions; real-time stock and pricing; product and sourcing information;
  planning and costing facilities, as well as intuitive complementary product suggestions.
* By using technology to deliver operational efficiency, implementing smart solutions faster through
  sharing of learning and ideas across our businesses, Bidfood is ahead of the pack. Continual
  upgrading, modernisation and simplification of our global IT infrastructure; from farm to fork.
[Customer service excellence ][54]
* Our mission is to deliver service excellence. Everything we do has the customer at heart, and is
  led by research and insights, be it into food trends to keep a step ahead of the curve, or the
  latest technological advances allowing us to continuously develop our service offering.
Each business is directly responsible for its product range, its buying and sales approach.
Businesses retain their local brand, tone of voice, look and feel. The cultural differences are
important to differentiate the regional locations. Each business operates as an autonomous, small,
local business.

coverage, economies of scale and one-stop solutions.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Edward Don & Company is the nation's leading distributor of foodservice equipment and supplies, offering a comprehensive range of products that includes fine china, flatware, glassware, heavy equipment, sanitation products, and disposables. # ABOUT US

Aperoliva is a company specialized in th** Import and Export of olive and avocado oil in bul** of
the best quality.Our work begins with the selection of the best fruits to ensure that our oils meet
the highest quality standards. Therefore, we select our suppliers from among the best oil producers
in **Spain, Portugal, Greece and Italy** and we make sure that the elaboration of the oils is
carried out following the production protocols.

Aperoliva’s team consists of professionals with proven knowledge in the interpretation and analysis
of the physicochemical parameters of purity and organoleptic parameters of the oil and is trained to
offer the best service to our customers.

Currently, we export our oils in bulk to companies throughout **Europe, Asia, USA, Canada, South
America, Australia, Russia and the United Arab Emirate**.

As for what identifies us, we like to define ourselves as a **quality company**: quality in the
selection of suppliers, quality in the product and quality in the service we offer.

# ABOUT US

Aperoliva is a company specialized in th** Import and Export of olive and avocado oil in bul** of
the best quality.Our work begins with the selection of the best fruits to ensure that our oils meet
the highest quality standards. Therefore, we select our suppliers from among the best oil producers
in **Spain, Portugal, Greece and Italy** and we make sure that the elaboration of the oils is
carried out following the production protocols.

Aperoliva’s team consists of professionals with proven knowledge in the interpretation and analysis
of the physicochemical parameters of purity and organoleptic parameters of the oil and is trained to
offer the best service to our customers.

Currently, we export our oils in bulk to companies throughout **Europe, Asia, USA, Canada, South
America, Australia, Russia and the United Arab Emirate**.

As for what identifies us, we like to define ourselves as a **quality company**: quality in the
selection of suppliers, quality in the product and quality in the service we offer.

## Fresh Organic Avocado

**Avodemia is one of Kenya’s leading avocado exporters, connecting premium-quality Kenyan avocados
to global markets.**
We specialize in exporting high-quality fresh avocados that are carefully handpicked and subjected
to strict quality control before final export, ensuring every fruit meets international standards.
For avocado farmers in Kenya, Avodemia offers a trusted market partner committed to quality, fair
partnerships, and helping growers unlock the full value of their harvest.

# About Us

“We don’t just supply commodities. We deliver consistency, quality, and trust in every shipment.
From sourcing to export, every product reflects our commitment to global standards.”

Goshen Agro Commodities Limited*

[leaf] Trusted Agro Export Company

## Premium Agro Commodities export from across Africa and beyond

Goshen Agro Commodities Limited bridges the gap between Africa’s rich agricultural heritage and the
global marketplace. By integrating a traceable supply chain with sustainable local sourcing, we
deliver premium-grade commodities to international partners while empowering the farming communities
that grow them.

###### Business Focus:

Sourcing, aggregation, processing, and export of premium agricultural commodities while
strengthening rural farmer capacity in sustainable agriculture

## In The Foodservice Industry

More than 100 years of experience and adaptation

We deliver success through a blend of proven expertise and willingness to embrace change. Yes, we
started delivering food in 1885, but we’ve never stopped moving or rested on our laurels. We are
always looking for fresh ideas, simple solutions and new ways to serve our customers, while using
the knowledge we’ve gained to streamline our operations and processes. That’s why our customers
count on us for safety and efficiency, but also to show them what’s coming next.




Jamie Guadagnino

## Developing Your Future

Jamie Guadagnino, Vice President of Sales, Vistar

Jamie Guadagnino began her journey with PFG over 20 years ago as a Customer Service Representative.
She advanced through a variety of positions over the years and through hard work and commitment, she
is now Vice President of Sales, Vistar.

I value the trust and investment that PFG places in my development. I still have much to learn in my
current role, and look forward to working here for many more years to come.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Wigmore Trading is West Africa’s fastest growing Trader and Wholesale Distributor based in Lagos Nigeria. Our focus is to source quality branded goods worldwide at low and competitive prices to satisfy the ever increasing demand in West Africa. We carry a wide range of both food and non-food products. We specialise in Health and Beauty Aids, Confectionery, Groceries, Household, Wines & Spirits and Baby Care products with consistent availability, exceptional lead times and maximum product shelf life. Our strong growth is attributed to a competent team, all highly skilled in the intended industry with a wealth of experience. We are proud to boast an excellent customer service, which has created long-term relationships with customers and enabled us to retain their interest for future order creation. We specialise in buying and selling bulk, clearance lines and job lots to enable us to pass great savings to our customers. Such economies of scale at our disposal are extended to our customers, who benefit from the lowest prices, assisted with an excellent service and a high level of order accuracy. We understand the importance of goods delivery occurs in a timely and secure fashion. We take utmost care in providing the most efficient and reliable professionals in logistics for packaging, consolidating and shipping goods. This is available in a variety of forms, multi-temperature, door-to-door, road, sea, and air freight. Ever changing and exciting promotions keep the business alive and provide endless opportunities together with terrific value for money deals on essential products that our exporters need. Over the years we have continuously invested in our growth as we are delivering at an increasingly high standard to our customers.

_crawl.about: Intercontinental Specialty Fats Sdn. Bhd. (“ISF) is a privately-owned company headquartered at Port Klang, Malaysia, established in 1980. As a leading manufacturer of palm specialty fats and oils, ISF owns and operates refining and downstream processing facilities across Peninsular Malaysia, with a dedicated workforce exceeding 700 employees. Additionally, we maintain a sales and distribution office in Shanghai, China, strategically positioned to support and empower local businesses. In 2018, we expanded our operations with the establishment of a refinery in Italy, enhancing the refinement process for ISF products originating from our Malaysian facilities before distributing them across Europe. ISF is a subsidiary of The Nisshin OilliO Group, Ltd., the largest vegetable oil company in Japan. Our expertise lies in sourcing raw materials locally and produces a wide range of quality-grade palm specialty oils and fats which cater to the needs of customers in over 50 countries worldwide today.

We believe in the power of good food—to bring people together and make moments special. Every product, every order, and every decision we make is inspired by the people on the other side of the plate. We distribute to foodservice operators throughout the Midwest, Northeast, Southeast and Southwest regions of the U.S. and coast to coast in Canada. Our company also operates more than 170 Gordon Food Service Stores, which are open to the public and provide the benefits of restaurant-quality products and friendly, knowledgeable service. Gordon Food Service Stores do not charge a membership fee. Gordon Food Service Stores are the primary supplier for many small foodservice operators, including: restaurants, churches, daycare providers, caterers, event planners, and other small businesses. We offer a broad range of employment opportunities throughout our corporate offices, distribution centers, and retail stores. We have a strong commitment to our employees and foster an environment that promotes internal growth, training, and career development opportunities. We pursue strategic partnerships to maximise the trade objectives for Victoria and the Government’s broader economic, social, and sustainability objectives. Global Victoria – inspiring global possibilities!

_crawl.about: FairPrice Group was established in 2019 by bringing together NTUC FairPrice, NTUC Foodfare and Kopitiam to cater to evolving consumer needs. Together with NTUC Link, we optimise the resources of our social enterprises and leverage their respective strengths to deliver quality, affordability, convenience and an enjoyable experience for all. With an extensive network of over 570 touchpoints as well as online, we provide an integrated array of products and services on Everything Food - from groceries, ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat offerings, to on-premise meals and food take-aways. Our Fairmily of over 13,000 employees are driven by our common purpose of nourishing generations and making life better for all. We are proud to serve our community and we do good by giving back to Singapore. Our impact touches people from all walks of life, from newborns to the elderly. We are here to make a difference – in the past, present and for generations to come. If you share our passion for Everything Food, Everything Good, Everyone, Every Day, join our Fairmily now!

_crawl.linkedin_about: In the crowded world of export import business, finding verified leads can feel like searching for a needle in a haystack. The global trade landscape holds potential, but without the right connections and trustworthy partners, growth can stall before it even begins. That’s where go4WorldBusiness steps in. With over two decades of experience, we are more than just another online B2B marketplace. We’re a global business network designed to help manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, importers, and trade professionals connect with verified buyers and suppliers who truly matter. At go4WorldBusiness.com, we know international trade is about people as much as products. That’s why our platform empowers SMEs to build reliable relationships that cross borders and open doors to real opportunities, helping you trade with confidence. #WeKeepItReal by putting transparency and trust at the core of everything we do. And because we stand by our promises, we offer a 60-day money-back guarantee on our memberships. Ready to move beyond endless searching and connect with buyers and suppliers with no hassle? It’s time to transform the way you trade, making it more reliable, efficient, and rewarding. Sign up today for FREE to find verified buyers and suppliers. Visit go4WorldBusiness.com now!

relevant_companies.summary: Kathmandu Organics is an online store that delivers organic, pesticide-free produces at your doorsteps. Our aim is to connect farmers with customers through fair pricing, use of technology and logistics solutions. Nepal’s organic food market has been fragile and dominated by middlemen who mostly take away profits from farmer and sell produces to urban market with high margin. Kathmandu Organics is a platform with fair pricing for everyone - a farmer can sell their produces at good rates & custom

relevant_companies.company_summary: Kathmandu Organics is an online platform that delivers organic, pesticide-free produce directly to consumers, aiming to bridge the gap between farmers and customers through fair pricing and efficient logistics. By eliminating middlemen, the company ensures that farmers receive better compensation for their products while offering customers high-quality organic goods at competitive prices. Targeting the growing demand for organic food in Nepal, Kathmandu Organics is committed to fostering a sustainable and equitable food market.

_crawl.about: Kathmandu Organics is an online store that delivers organic, pesticide-free produces at your doorsteps. Our aim is to connect farmers with customers through fair pricing, use of technology and logistics solutions. Nepal’s organic food market has been fragile and dominated by middlemen who mostly take away profits from farmer and sell produces to urban market with high margin. Kathmandu Organics is a platform with fair pricing for everyone - a farmer can sell their produces at good rates & customers will get high-quality products at competitive prices.

Targeting the growing demand for organic food in Nepal, Kathmandu Organics is committed to fostering a sustainable and equitable food market.

_crawl.about: Landema's mission is to make the best natural extracts available online - Essential Oils, Absolutes, Vegetable Oils, Macerates, Hydrolats - Professional Quality direct from the manufacturer! Landema is part of the Biolandes Group, a world-renowned producer of quality natural extracts. For over 40 years, the Group has been cultivating and processing the finest raw materials with a profound respect for nature and people, a state-of-the-art laboratory internationally recognized for its expertise, rigorous quality controls and strict, comprehensive traceability and regulatory documentation. The family-owned group, which has maintained its roots in the Landes region and its values of authenticity, benevolence and respect for the environment over the decades, supplies the world's leading perfume, cosmetics, aromatherapy and wellness companies with unfailing quality, reliability and integrity. With Landema, the Group has established specific processes and resources optimized for online sales and the processing of orders with no minimum quantity, both in bulk and in individual bottles. What's more, for the first time ever, Landema is making the Biolandes Group's exceptional essential oils and natural extracts available to consumers !

_crawl.about: Welcome to Turkana Food, your ultimate destination for premium food products from around the world. Our journey began with a simple vision: to introduce the diverse and rich culinary traditions of Europe, Turkey, the Middle East, and the Balkans to the customers of the United States and Canada. With a deep appreciation for food and culture, we carefully curate our product selection to ensure that every item meets our high standards of quality, authenticity, and taste. At Turkana Food, we believe that food has the power to bring people together, to create memorable moments, and to celebrate the richness of different cultures. That's why we offer a wide range of products that cater to every palate and preference. With a legacy spanning 15 years, Turkana Food has established itself as a dependable source for all your grocery, dairy, bakery, frozen products, and household needs. Our extensive inventory boasts an impressive selection of over 1700 SKUs, ensuring that we have something for everyone at a price that fits your budget. What sets us apart is our commitment to excellence in every aspect of our business. We work closely with trusted suppliers and producers who share our passion for exceptional quality. We take pride in our exceptional customer service, striving to provide a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience for every customer. Food business success goes far beyond great food. At Turkana Food, we think deeper about your business - what's working and what potential lies ahead. From finance to operations, to driving traffic, we're with you as partners on the whole journey. We invite you to explore our website, browse through our enticing products at: www.turkanafoods.com

### About Alex Lee  

Alex Lee, Inc., is one of the largest grocery retail and wholesale distribution companies in the
southeastern United States. We are the parent company of wholesale distributors Merchants
Distributors (MDI), Souto Foods, W. Lee Flowers, and Import Mex, as well as grocery banners Lowes
Foods and Kj’s Market. In total, we operate in 13 states; own over 140 retail stores; serve over
1,960 stores in wholesale; and count close to 15,000 people as part of the Alex Lee family.

### History  

Alex Lee has remained privately held for over 90 years and now spans four generations. We benefit
from a history of always doing what is best for our customers, as well as our Alex Lee values. While
we continue to build onto our strong foundation and look to our past for guidance, we are
future-facing. We are passionate about embracing innovation and growth as we look to the future as a
trusted partner for our customers.

[Learn More][17]

### Careers at Alex Lee  

Growth is our only option – this applies to our business, our customers, and our people. We want
Alex Lee to be a place where people want to stay and grow their careers, which is why we offer
pathways for professional advancement and continued education and development. This is why Alex Lee
is recognized by our employees as being a place where they see themselves crafting a lifelong
career.

Keith Foods offers customers more than 20,000 products, consisting of national brands as well as its own exclusive brands, in all broad line distribution categories – dairy, fresh and frozen meats, frozen foods, produce, poultry, seafood, disposables, and restaurant equipment and supplies. # Váš výrobce a **distributor potravin**

#### Stojíme po Vašem boku v podnikání.
#### Dodáváme čerstvé, mražené i trvanlivé potraviny, které přivezeme až k Vašim dveřím. Nabízíme
#### jednoduché způsoby objednávání. Jsme tu pro všechny, kdo chtějí mít jistotu kvality,
#### spolehlivého servisu a osobního přístupu.
* [Pomůžeme s podnikáním]
  
  ### Pomůžeme Vám s podnikáním
  
  Náš prodejní tým je připraven pomoci Vám s výběrem sortimentu, přinášet inspiraci a podpořit růst
  Vašeho podnikání. Jsme Vaší každodenní oporou – od řízení zásob a zvládání provozních starostí až
  po zavádění nových trendů a technologií.
* [Nákladní auto Bidfood ikona]
  
  ### Zboží Vám přivezeme
  
  Čerstvé, mražené i trvanlivé potraviny doručíme rychle a spolehlivě po celé České republice – až
  šestkrát týdně. Díky moderní flotile aut s oddělenými teplotními zónami k Vám vše dorazí najednou
  a v perfektní kvalitě.
* [Zboží Bidfood ikona]
  
  ### Osvědčené produkty
  
  Nabízíme široký sortiment od cenově výhodných produktů až po prémiové delikatesy. Kombinujeme
  vlastní výrobu, regionální dodavatele i světové značky, abyste měli možnost výběru přesně podle
  svých potřeb. 
* [Objednání]
  
  ### Jednoduché objednání
  
  Nakupovat u nás je snadné – objednávat můžete prostřednictvím obchodního zástupce, zákaznického
  centra, e‑shopu nebo mobilní aplikace. Vždy rychle, přehledně a s podporou, na kterou se můžete
  spolehnout.

Bidfood Czech Republic operates an assortment of approximately of 5000 items from which 1500 is produced in Bidfood production facilities in Czech Republic and the rest is outsourced. ### **We help you protect & enhance your reputation**
### 
### Safely manage your risks associated with food & product consumption
### 

Food safety and efficient cold chain management directly impact your business success, reputation,
profitability, and most importantly, the health and satisfaction of your patrons. Join other
businesses owners, chefs, restaurateurs, managers, and other decision-makers who call us their
preferred supplier.

At Bidfood, we engage with reputable supply partners, we continuously maintain and update food
safety and religious certifications, we ensure products are packed and labelled correctly to comply
with local regulations, and we engage with our suppliers to resolve complaints. Customers and
suppliers can rest assured that where necessary, products can be promptly recalled, mitigating
consumer hazards.

We know that management of the cold chain is critical to customer satisfaction, and product safety
and quality guarantees.

### Collaborations

#### Working with some of the voices that help shape South African foodservice

We work closely with leading industry platforms, events and associations to stay connected to what
matters most in foodservice.
By collaborating with trusted brands and industry voices, we strengthen our ability to add value
beyond supply, keeping our customers informed, inspired and ahead of the curve.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Bidfood is a leading broad line supplier of frozen, chilled, ambient grocery and allied products to businesses in the foodservice industry across South Africa and parts of Africa. We are the preferred supply partner for over 27 000 customers looking for quality food and related products delivered to their door. We are proud of our ability to provide a complete one stop solution that encompasses a wide range of products and services, tailored to help our customers grow. With 18 branches located in major provinces our national footprint is strategically placed to fully service the needs of businesses in the foodservice industry. We service a broad range of customers in the hospitality and industrial catering industries such as restaurants, hotels, coffee shops, canteens, conference venues, hospitals, schools, old age homes, etc. We have a wide range of products ranging from food to packaging and cleaning materials as well as foodservice equipment to satisfy their individual needs.

_crawl.linkedin_about: In business since 1999, Discovery Organics is an independently owned Canadian distributor of Certified Organic and Fair Trade produce. We passionately work to promote Certified Organic and Fair Trade by building relationships with small scale farmers here at home, as well as abroad. We serve hundreds of customers, including natural food retailers and wholesalers across Western Canada and the Canadian North. We got into this business because we wanted to help small scale Certified Organic farmers here at home gain access to the larger commercial marketplace, and to ensure their families and communities thrive. Over the past decade or so, we have endeavoured to do this, step by step, with over ninety B.C. farms. Our hearts still belong to the small scale growers, family farms and agricultural co-ops. We have visited dozens of farms across B.C., working with growers to see them move to larger and more financially sustainable operations. We feel encouraged by the impressive increase in consumer demand for Certified Organics and local. We also acknowledge that we might not be able to grow all our own food year round. Even more so now, as our climate changes, no harvest is a safe bet. So over the years, we have extended our relationships with small scale farmers to include farms down the Pacific Coast, through Washington, Oregon and California, then on to Mexico and South America. Together, this network of growers keep us all fed, year round, and for this we are grateful.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Gordon Food Service offers a broad range of employment opportunities throughout our corporate offices, distribution centers, and retail stores. We have a strong commitment to our employees and foster an environment that promotes internal growth, training, and career development opportunities. We’ve grown to become the largest family-operated distributor in North America by upholding the same business approach since 1897—being passionately committed to the people we serve. We believe in the power of good food—to bring people together and make moments special. Every product, every order and every decision we make is inspired by the people on the other side of the plate. We partner with foodservice operations to provide the quality products and solutions our customers need to continue to drive their success. From remaining compliant with industry regulations to helping them plan their menu, we give them our best—so they can serve just that to their own customers. _crawl.linkedin_about: As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future. We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland. Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020. Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. _crawl.linkedin_about: Our mission is to make it easy for everyone to enjoy chef quality ingredients. Our vision is to be the first choice in sustainable foodservice and make a positive impact on people, communities and the environment that we work in. At JJ Foodservice, we care about offering quality food and exceptional service. That’s why when you shop with us, you can enjoy amazing ingredients, exclusive products and a friendly team that cares. Our business was started by a former restauranteur, back in 1988, who made it his mission to improve the quality of wholesale food and service. Many years later, that passion for food still runs strong throughout our business. Our team are total foodies, who care about offering the best customer experience. That’s why we regularly test products to make sure they continue to meet the highest quality (and tastiness) standards. We’re proud to offer product quality that you can rely on, and consistency that helps to keep dishes tasting great, every time. Getting our products to you, quickly, is our number one priority. Which is why our branches are open every day for collection. And we offer fast online ordering, for collection or delivery, on the website or app. Many of our products are exclusive – you simply can’t get them anywhere else, which is just another great reason to shop with us. Whether you’re running a restaurant or entertaining at home, we’re confident you will enjoy great service from start to finish.

### PORT International

„Partner for Generations“

Bei uns dreht sich alles um frisches Obst & Gemüse von allen Kontinenten der Welt. Unsere
Kernkompetenz ist der Direktimport, bei dem Frische und Qualität im Mittelpunkt stehen. Mit viel
Leidenschaft und fachlichem Know-how stellen wir uns den täglichen Herausforderungen, um unseren
Kunden des Groß- und Einzelhandels beste Qualität und Frische zu liefern.

Zu unseren Partnern weltweit pflegen wir enge und persönliche Beziehungen. Da wir uns in der
Verantwortung sehen, einen fairen Handel zu unterstützen und die Welt auch für nachfolgende
Generationen zu erhalten, bieten wir Bio-, Fairtrade- und klimaneutrale Produkte an.

Mit einer über 145-jährigen Fruchthandelserfahrung der Familie PORT zählen wir zu den führenden
Fruchtdienstleistern in ganz Europa.

### DAFÜR STEHEN WIR

Unsere individuellen Lösungen und Frischekonzepte garantieren Qualität auf höchstem Niveau. Wir
stehen für eine persönliche Beratung, ständige Lieferbereitschaft und flexible Problemlösungen.

Als Komplettlieferant vereinen wir vier hochspezialisierte Einheiten unter einem Dach und können
unsere Kunden somit rund um die Uhr mit Obst und Gemüse aus der ganzen Welt beliefern.

Eine partnerschaftliche Beziehung zu unseren Kunden, Logistikpartnern und Produzenten ist die Basis
unseres Erfolgs.

**UNSERE VISION **
Wir ermöglichen eine faire, gesunde und gleichzeitig klimabewusste Ernährung mit frischem Obst und
Gemüse.

**UNSERE MISSION**
Als „Partner for Generations“ gehen wir auch in Zukunft mit qualitativ hochwertigen
Produktinnovationen voran. Wir stehen für ein Umdenken zu klimafreundlichen Produkten ein und
reduzieren durch innovative Technologien und die gezielte Auswahl unserer Partner die CO₂-Emissionen
entlang der Lieferkette auf ein Minimum. Darüber hinaus werden wir unseren Einfluss geltend machen,
um die gesamte Lieferkette Schritt für Schritt so klimafreundlich wie möglich zu gestalten. Hierzu
zählen u. a. auch Verpackungsinnovationen für eine umweltfreundlichere Distribution.

###### Rooted in Canada

### Are you a Foodie? Order Now!

From coast to coast, Sysco has thousands of foodservice products in stock. From top quality protein
to fresh produce and all of your grocery needs, start ordering today for delivery or pick up as
early as tomorrow and become a Sysco Foodie!

Are you already a customer?

Are you looking to buy foodservice products for your business?
* [Order Now][62]

### Sustaining Our Future

Sysco has a passion for helping others. We proudly partner with more local ranchers, growers, and
producers than any distributor in the industry. We support farm to table initiatives to deliver the
best products from anywhere, to everywhere. Sysco has partnerships with food banks and other hunger
relief organizations to invest in the needs of diverse communities around the world. Fighting hunger
is a vital part of Sysco’s heart
* [Learn More][63]
* [View Sustainability Reports][64]

## Our Locations

Sysco operates approximately 343 distribution facilities serving more than 650,000 customer
locations around the world.

[Get In Touch][65]
Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing and distributing food and related products to
customers who prepare meals away from home. This includes restaurants, healthcare and educational
facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues, and more. Sysco operates 340 distribution
centers, in over 10 countries, with 76,000 colleagues serving approximately 730,000 customer
locations. The company generated sales of more than $78 billion in fiscal year 2024 that ended June
29, 2024. As the world’s largest food-away-from-home distributor, Sysco offers customized supply
chain solutions, bespoke specialty product offerings, and culinary support to drive customers to
innovate and optimize their operations. We act as a trusted business partner to our customers,
helping them grow through our industry-leading portfolio that includes fresh produce, premium
proteins, specialty products, sustainably focused items, equipment and supplies, and innovative
culinary solutions. For more information, visit www.sysco.com. For important news and key
information for Sysco investors, visit the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at
investors.sysco.com.

No two customers have the same specific needs which is why we’re well-equipped to serve diverse
industries through 13 unique channels and provide tailored solutions to suit your short and
long-term business efforts.

[Learn More][63]

Across our 24 nationwide distribution centers, we provide an extensive range of well-known candy,
snack, and beverage brands, along with unique and innovative products. To enhance the user

ordering process.

We are committed to supporting and empowering the communities we serve through active partnerships
with organizations like St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, Truckers Against Trafficking, and
local community initiatives. By living up to this commitment, we make a significant contribution to
the betterment of real communities everywhere.

employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. By investing in our workforce and providing

and propels growth.

_crawl.about: PriceSmart is the original membership club and the largest in Central America, Colombia and the Caribbean, working with its members and suppliers to provide low unit prices on a hand-picked selection of high-quality items and services in a reliable, safe and fun shopping experience. With over 47 clubs in 13 countries, PriceSmart serves more than 3 million members. Additionally, we work in conjunction with Price Philanthropies, to support our local communities in the countries in which we operate, with programs such as Aprender y Crecer, under which we provide school supplies and resources to students, teachers and local schools.

_crawl.linkedin_about: HANOS is dé internationale horeca groothandel en totaalleverancier voor de horeca, grootverbruikers en bedrijvenmarkt. HANOS is als horeca groothandel uitgegroeid tot een organisatie met achttien vestigingen verspreid over Nederland en België. Onze vestigingen zijn bijzonder sfeervol ingericht en het assortiment, dat kunt u het beste zelf komen ervaren. Ook voor het aan huis leveren van uw bestellingen is HANOS de aangewezen leverancier van levensmiddelen en non-food producten. Met ons eigen distributienetwerk levert HANOS in heel Nederland, België en Duitsland. Bij HANOS vindt u het grootste topkwaliteit assortiment voor foodprofessionals onder één dak. Food, non-food en heel veel vers. Al net zo exclusief en voordelig zijn onze delicatessen, wijnen en andere dranken. En maatwerk leveren wij onder andere op het gebied van bedrijfskleding, horecakeukens en projectinrichting. Bij ons staat het belang van de klant voorop. Persoonlijke benadering met een groot gevoel voor service, daar staan wij voor!

Serving Independent Grocers Since 1940

[ BECOME A MEMBER RETAILER ][18]

# Our Purpose

In 1940 the grocery industry was a rough place for independent retailers. Strong competition from
national chains, increased prices from wholesalers and low margins left many families and
independently-owned businesses with boarded windows. Determined to succeed against the competition,
34 independent retailers and Donald P. Lloyd, the then president of the Utah Grocers Association,
joined together to combine their buying power and open a warehouse, leading to the birth of AFS.

# OUr HISTORY

# **The Story of AFS**

Since 1940 we have grown from 34 retailers in Utah to nearly 450 independent grocers across Utah,
Idaho, Colorado, Wyoming, Montana, Nevada, Arizona, New Mexico, and Oregon.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR HISTORY ][19]

_crawl.about: Anecoop es una empresa cooperativa de segundo grado, del sector hortofrutícola, integrada por 93 cooperativas agrícolas de toda España. Su principal objeto es la comercialización de los productos hortofrutícolas de las cooperativas asociadas, así como de vinos y aceite de oliva. Desde su fundación hace 35 años, ha logrado posicionarse como : - la primera empresa hortofrutícola del Mediterráneo, - líder español en la comercialización de frutas y hortalizas, - primer exportador y segundo comercializador de cítricos del mundo y - el primer operador de sandías y kakis a nivel europeo. Es una de las empresas españolas más internacionalizadas, con estructura internacional propia. Anecoop cuenta con empresas filiales repartidas por toda Europa (Francia, Inglaterra, Polonia, Holanda, República Checa, Rusia) además de oficinas comerciales en España. En la actualidad, Anecoop exporta la producción de sus cooperativas a más de 50 países.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Established in 1992, and now trading for over 25 years, Burley Hydraulics (Cambridgeshire) Limited was originally set up to offer local industries a repair service on hydraulic hose assemblies and associated products from our trade counter based in St. Ives. Since then we have grown to meet our diverse range of customer’s requirements and now operate from premises of over 5,000 Sq. Ft. Ideally located close to the A14, M11 & M6 Motorways. Since 2001 Burley Hydraulics has been a proud member of the BFPDA, British Fluid Power Distribution Association. This is for our use of recognised quality assurance procedures within the industry and distributing products in a professional and ethical way. All our staff members work within the strict guide lines of the BFPDA, and regularly attend training courses held by the NFPC, the National Fluid Power Centre. We are a registered BFPDA ‘Approved Hose Assemblies'​ company. Awarded for our excellent manufacturing & testing facilities. Whether you are a small business looking for spares on your plant or agricultural equipment or a large OEM looking for contracted hose assembly production Burley Hydraulics are here to meet your needs. Our fully equipped workshop can build and test, up to 1500 Bar, a vast range of hose assemblies from test point hoses to large bore 6 wire multi spiral. With our vehicle tracking we can advise an accurate eta to any breakdown, however we aim to reach all breakdowns within 1hr. At the end of 2016 we introduced our new hydraulic cylinder repair centre. We are now happy to be able to offer a full hydraulic cylinder repair, from the simple re-seal to bespoke cylinder design including welding and machining. Our skilled technicians have over 10 years’ experience and can fully test and build any hydraulic cylinder. We are also able to complete emergency repairs with a 24-hour turnaround. Burley Hydraulics can also supply, repair, test and service a vast array of hydraulic pumps motors and valves.

## What inspires us?

When people around the world can achieve better lives for themselves, their families, and their
communities, we all benefit. By fostering a secure global environment, we contribute to a safe,
peaceful, and prosperous world for all.

## a legacy of global impact

ACDI/VOCA is a global nonprofit development design and delivery partner based in Washington, D.C. We
have implemented effective economic and social development projects since 1963. We address issues of
food security, economic prosperity, and social engagement by facilitating the creation of durable,
locally driven market, food, and social systems in communities around the world.

## The systems we design and implement result in:

## **Thriving Economies**

We connect people with businesses to create jobs
and strengthen economic market systems.

## **Fair societies**

We support social systems that engage, benefit, and empower all members: women and men, youth and
adults, and rural as well as urban families.

## **Resilient Communities**

We help communities build resilience to conflict,
extreme weather, and other shocks and stresses.

## **Sustainable Food Systems**

We enhance food security among poor
and vulnerable populations.

_crawl.linkedin_about: First launched in 2008 by Geoff Bartakovics and acquired by Static Media in 2021, Tasting Table is dedicated to serving the modern food and drink enthusiast through content that is informative, useful, and engaging. We provide our global audience of 18 million monthly visitors with expert-backed dining advice, practical tips, must-try recipes, and the most relevant news influencing the food and restaurant world today. We also regularly interview notable celebrity chefs and review the trendiest grocery products and hottest new kitchen equipment on the market, offering our honest insight that helps you decide whether something is worth your money. At Tasting Table, we recognize our readers come to us with different experiences and backgrounds. Our editorial team aims to make Tasting Table a platform where both cooks and eaters can come for resources and creative inspiration, regardless of their skill level. Whether you're here to get the scoop on the latest drink trends or learn how to make perfect chocolate eclairs, we want you to know we've got you. We also hope to encourage you to be curious and try new things. That's why along with our extensive catalog of original recipes and how-to guides, you'll find stories on our site that explore the history and cultural context behind ingredients and cuisine. As a Static Media brand, we're committed to excellence in editorial standards. Our recipes are thoroughly tested and edited by a dedicated team of contributors that includes registered dietitians, published cookbook authors, former chefs, educators from NYC's Institute of Culinary Education, and experienced home cooks who ensure they're easy-to-understand for various skill levels.

The company offers expert-backed dining advice, practical tips, and a diverse array of recipes, catering to cooks and eaters of all skill levels. With a commitment to editorial excellence, Tasting Table features thoroughly tested content, including interviews with celebrity chefs and insights into the latest culinary trends and products.
