_crawl.linkedin_about: Tokopedia is an Indonesian technology company with a mission to democratize commerce through technology. Since its founding in 2009, Tokopedia has been a force that pioneers digital transformation in Indonesia. Consistent in building a bridge to connect millions of people, we have now reached more than 99% of districts and empowered more than 14 million registered merchants across Indonesia. Our vision is to build a Super Ecosystem where anyone can start and discover anything. To achieve that, we are working hand in hand with various strategic partners while also providing more than 500,000 payment points across Indonesia, and offering more than 40 digital products that simplify the lives of many. We have grown rapidly and currently have more than 3,800 Nakama spread across several regions; Jakarta, Semarang, and Yogyakarta. In 2021, Tokopedia united with Gojek to become GoTo by combining e-commerce, on-demand, and financial and payment services. With a mission to empower progress, we continuously create a comprehensive ecosystem for daily life. Let’s #FindYourPurpose with us, and join our mission! www.tokopedia.com/careers IMPORTANT Tokopedia is affiliated with the GoTo Group companies, and all authentic jobs/open positions listed by Tokopedia can ONLY be accessed via our official channels which are Tokopedia on LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, and tokopedia.com/careers. Should you be contacted by our Recruitment team, please ensure that the communication and information are coming from a valid and verified Tokopedia domain - *@tokopedia.com. If you are contacted by any third party outside of the authenticated channels highlighted above, please write to us at recruitment@tokopedia.com to validate the job/open position. This is to avoid any potential instances of fraud and to ensure your safety and security during the job application process.

Bakker Barendrecht

Steeds meer mensen leven gezonder en bewuster. Als een van de grootste groente- en fruitbedrijven
van Nederland leveren we daar actief een bijdrage aan.

Dat doen we door samen met onze strategische partner Albert Heijn te zorgen voor de allerbeste
kwaliteit, het meest verrassende en duurzame aanbod voor een competitieve prijs. Neem bijvoorbeeld
de AH verspakketten: bijzondere maaltijden met veel verse groenten en precies op maat, geen
verspilling dus.

[ Lees meer over ons groene verhaal ][35]
Onze activiteiten
Bakker Barendrecht zorgt ervoor dat bij Albert Heijn dagelijks de allerbeste groenten en fruit in de
winkels ligt. Aan Koninklijke Vezet leveren we groenten en fruit voor hun kant-en-klare producten en
maaltijdoplossingen. In België en Luxemburg hebben we een strategisch partnerschap met Delhaize. In
Tsjechië werken we samen met Albert.
[ Lees hier meer over ons ][36]
Citaat

We werken met plezier samen met onze klanten en telers aan gezonde en smaakvolle producten!

Fresh/Bakker
Werken bij Bakker
Met een vers product werken, geeft een bijzondere en afwisselende dynamiek. Dat vergt creativiteit
en eigen initiatief. We willen voorop lopen in ons internationale speelveld. Werken bij Bakker, is
werken in een fijne omgeving, met goede arbeidsomstandigheden en aandacht voor persoonlijke
ontwikkeling.
[ Lees hier meer over werken bij Bakker ][37]
Waar zitten we?
Onze locaties
Nederland
In Ridderkerk regelen we onze commerciële en logistieke activiteiten. Onze ondersteunende diensten
zijn hier ook gehuisvest.

Tsjechië
Vanuit onze vestiging in Divišov voorzien we supermarktketen Albert dagelijks van de beste groente-
en fruitproducten.

België
Bakker Belgium is strategisch partner van Delhaize. We leveren een groot deel van het verse groente-
en fruitassortiment aan de distributiecentra van de Belgische supermarktketen.

[ Klik hier voor ons adres ][38]
[Martijn Hendrikx - teler homepage]
Onze telers
Van zaadje tot product
Onze groenten en fruit halen we zo dichtbij als mogelijk en zo ver weg als nodig. We werken, vaak al
tientallen jaren, samen met vaste telers.
[ Lees meer over onze telers ][39]
[Werken bij - Nicole]
Citaat
‘Ik heb hier geleerd dat je veel meer kunt dan je denkt.’
Als trainee begin je vaak met meedraaien in de productie, als teamleider. Zo leer je de
basisprocessen van Bakker kennen, en snap je ook het effect van een besluit op een andere afdeling.
Eén dag per week werk je aan een project heel ergens anders in het bedrijf. Je wordt wel in het
diepe gegooid: we gaan je op die afdeling plaatsen, probeer het maar uit. Ik heb door die aanpak
geleerd dat je veel meer kunt dan je denkt.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Creed Foodservice is one of the UK’s leading foodservice wholesalers, delivering high-quality, multi-temperature products and tailored supply solutions to businesses across the industry—from independent operators to national groups. Built on strong family values, we pride ourselves on exceptional customer care, long-term partnerships, and a reliable, sustainable service. Our commitment to both our people and our customers has been recognised through multiple industry awards, including Best Companies Two-Star Status (2023), FWD Foodservice Wholesaler of the Year (2021), and the Diversity in Wholesale Award (2024). With strategically located depots nationwide, we provide a comprehensive product range across frozen, chilled, and ambient categories—from fresh produce and high-welfare meat to dry goods and non-food essentials. Our expert teams work closely with customers to deliver consistent quality and flexible solutions that meet the evolving needs of the foodservice sector. At Creed Foodservice, we go beyond supply—we partner with our customers to help them succeed.

_crawl.linkedin_about: METRO is a leading international food wholesaler which specialises in serving the needs of hotels, restaurants, and caterers (HoReCa) as well as independent merchants (Traders). Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for the needs of professional customers which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019. Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP. METRO operates in more than 30 countries and employs over 85,000 people worldwide. In financial year 2023/24, METRO generated sales of €31 billion. More information can be found at MPULSE.de, our online magazine. Data protection notice: https://www.metroag.de/en/data-privacy/social-media Imprint: https://www.metroag.de/en/imprint

VÉLEZ MÁLAGA y **por otra parte encontramos la reciente sede en** FRANCIA, PARÍS. **Ambas cuentan
con instalaciones apropiadas para la **exportación e importación** de aguacate y mango.

 

Nuestras sedes cuentan con la mejor tecnología para el buen tratamiento de las frutas tropicales.

 

La matriz se encuentra en Málaga, al sur de España, disponiendo de unas instalaciones de 52.000 m2
distribuidos entre oficinas, laboratorios, almacén, muelles, cámaras frigoríficas y de maduración,
zonas verdes y campo experimental de ensayo.

 

Disponemos de la última tecnología en maquinaria controlando el daño interno por pieza y permitiendo
controlar la maduración deseada según pedido.

 

Controlamos los parámetros de la fruta con la medición de la firmeza, el daño interno, el % de grasa
y los grados brix, así como los parámetros de las cámaras regulando la temperatura, la humedad y el
etileno.

### Instalaciones

52.000 metros cuadrados entre oficinas, almacén, laboratorios, muelles, cámaras frigoríficas y de
maduración, zonas verdes y campo experimental de ensayo.

9 cámaras frigoríficas

4 cámaras de maduración

1 túnel de enfriamiento

7 muelles de carga y descarga

1 muelle de campo

**Reyes Gutiérrez** somos una empresa productora y exportadora de mangos y aguacates, frutas
tropicales de alto consumo en el mundo. Nuestra misión es llevar a diferentes partes del mundo estas
frutas frescas para su consumo.

 

En nuestra página encontrará todos los [tipos de aguacate][51] que distribuimos, así como todos los
[tipos de mango][52]. De igual forma, hacemos hincapié en sus **beneficios para la salud** por
consumirlos, propiedades y características, entre otras.

 

También es de destacar **las marcas bajo las cuales distribuimos la mayor variedad de frutas
tropicales**, todas frescas y de la mejor calidad.
* Casado
* Casado Premium
* Palta
* Reyes Gutiérrez 
* Casamaroc
* Avobio

En RG tenemos el objetivo de hacer que puedas **comprar aguacates y mangos de Málaga** de la mejor
calidad. Además, disponemos de contenido informativo. 

 

Desde recetas, artículos sobre salud y beneficios del consumo de ciertas frutas.

 

De igual manera ofrecemos entrevistas, noticias y notas informativas referentes al mundo agricultor
de frutas tropicales.

 

Por otro lado, nuestros certificados de calidad nos otorgan una mayor confianza.

Als Profipartner sichert Transgourmet Ihnen eine vollständige Warenversorgung und bietet umfassende
Unterstützung in allen Kernprozessen. Die Priorität liegt dabei auf** Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit**.
In Zusammenarbeit mit sorgfältig ausgewählten Lieferanten sorgt Transgourmet für frische,
hochwertige Produkte aus regionaler Herkunft und internationalen Märkten. Von frischem Obst und
Gemüse über hochwertiges Fleisch, erlesene Weine bis hin zu innovativen Food-Konzepten – hier finden
Sie alles, was Sie für Ihre Küche und Ihren Betrieb benötigen.

Mit persönlicher und kompetenter Fachberatung, ganzheitlichen Konzepten und innovativen Lösungen
unterstützt Transgourmet Sie nachhaltig dabei, effizienter und besser zu werden. Dazu gehören sowohl
eine individuelle Beratung und ein effizientes Bestell- und Liefersystem als auch Schulungen und
Workshops, um Ihnen wichtige Themen der Branche zu vermitteln, neue Inspirationen zu setzen und Ihre
kulinarischen Visionen in die Realität umzusetzen.

### Customer-Centric Approach

Delivering an exceptional customer experience is our top priority. From independent stores to large
chain-operators, we are dedicated to our customers’ success and growth. Our culture is one of
innovation, integrity, and daily commitment to our customers and their businesses.

[Learn About Us][77]

### The Leader in Convenience Foodservice

Core-Mark, a distinguished member of the Performance Food Group family of companies, has established
itself as the largest and most highly-regarded marketer of consumer goods in North America. Our
commitment to crafting pioneering programs and offering best-selling products is fundamental to our
success, but more importantly, to the success of our customers.

[Explore Foodservice Programs][78]

### The Future is Innovation

Our organization thrives on providing inventive solutions to customers, enabling them to stay ahead
in the markets they serve. We achieve this with technology services that give our customers access
to systems anywhere at any time, as well as by prioritizing fresh foodservice programs that surpass
the industry standards. Our team members are consistently inspired by the evolution of the market,
and we pride ourselves on our innovative product offerings and early-to-market merchandising
solutions. Ultimately, our unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction is what
drives us forward.

[Learn About Us][79]

### Technology Leading the Way

At Core-Mark, we recognize the pivotal role that technology plays for our customers, which is why we
offer a robust suite of applications to enhance their interaction with us. This includes tools that
enable customers to place orders, track deliveries, and manage other critical aspects of their
business. Moreover, we provide solutions that cater to the evolving needs of today's consumers, such
as loyalty programs designed for independent and larger operators and frictionless check-out
options. We are committed to ongoing investment in technology that will keep our customers on the
cutting edge.

[See Our Technology][80]


## Advanced Category Management

Our expert merchandising solutions, coupled with our comprehensive product assortment will help you
drive sales while engaging consumers. We utilize cutting-edge planogram technology and offer access
to first-to-market product offerings, data-driven insights and programs to ensure your execution at
retail. Leveraging our Assortment Optimization software, cloud-based space visualization and
exclusive trend analytics will help you sell more products and manage inventory more efficiently.

## IS OUR SUCCESS

## LEADING THE WAY
## WITH TECHNOLOGY

### Customer-Centric Approach

Delivering an exceptional customer experience is our top priority. From independent stores to large
chain-operators, we are dedicated to our customers’ success and growth. Our culture is one of
innovation, integrity, and daily commitment to our customers and their businesses.

[Learn About Us][77]

### The Leader in Convenience Foodservice

Core-Mark, a distinguished member of the Performance Food Group family of companies, has established
itself as the largest and most highly-regarded marketer of consumer goods in North America. Our
commitment to crafting pioneering programs and offering best-selling products is fundamental to our
success, but more importantly, to the success of our customers.

[Explore Foodservice Programs][78]

### The Future is Innovation

Our organization thrives on providing inventive solutions to customers, enabling them to stay ahead
in the markets they serve. We achieve this with technology services that give our customers access
to systems anywhere at any time, as well as by prioritizing fresh foodservice programs that surpass
the industry standards. Our team members are consistently inspired by the evolution of the market,
and we pride ourselves on our innovative product offerings and early-to-market merchandising
solutions. Ultimately, our unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction is what
drives us forward.

[Learn About Us][79]

### Technology Leading the Way

At Core-Mark, we recognize the pivotal role that technology plays for our customers, which is why we
offer a robust suite of applications to enhance their interaction with us. This includes tools that
enable customers to place orders, track deliveries, and manage other critical aspects of their
business. Moreover, we provide solutions that cater to the evolving needs of today's consumers, such
as loyalty programs designed for independent and larger operators and frictionless check-out
options. We are committed to ongoing investment in technology that will keep our customers on the
cutting edge.

[See Our Technology][80]


## Advanced Category Management

Our expert merchandising solutions, coupled with our comprehensive product assortment will help you
drive sales while engaging consumers. We utilize cutting-edge planogram technology and offer access
to first-to-market product offerings, data-driven insights and programs to ensure your execution at
retail. Leveraging our Assortment Optimization software, cloud-based space visualization and
exclusive trend analytics will help you sell more products and manage inventory more efficiently.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Bentex Group is comprised of multiple company’s each specializing and operating independently. The combined synergies provide a one-stop solution for our retail and licensing partners. Bentex sets itself apart through creativity, high quality, and customer service. This combined with a reputation for honesty and integrity, have been the hallmark of the company’s success over the last 78 years. Sales distribution in the U.S. covers the full retail spectrum from value through department and specialty stores. International distribution includes Canada, Mexico, Latin America, Central America, South America, Europe, and Australia. Bentex has a dedicated Walmart team based in Bentonville, AR. We are committed to superior quality, value, and social compliance in our factories and on-time delivery. “Quick Response” is a critical strength that allows the company to turn product in 10 days (domestically) to 60 days (overseas). Benefits include: - Maximizing business by responding to open-to-buy opportunities and unexpected in-season needs. - Having a quicker response to emerging fashion trends. - Minimizing retailer risk by allowing for commitments closer to season.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Als führendes Unternehmen im Schweizer Abhol- und Belieferungsgrosshandel versorgen wir durch unsere 31 Abholmärkte und acht regionalen Logistikzentren rund 100`000 Kunden. Mit über 25`000 Artikeln bieten wir ein Vollsortiment für Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Gemeinschaftsverpflegung und Detailhandel. Unser Frische-Sortiment in den Bereichen Früchte und Gemüse, Fleisch, Fisch sowie Molkerei- und Backwaren umfasst mehr als 5`000 Artikel. Bei der Sortimentsgestaltung reduzieren wir soziale und ökologische Risiken entlang der Wertschöpfungskette und steigern das Angebot an biologisch, artgerechten und fair hergestellten Produkten stetig. Kein anderer Anbieter in der Schweiz verfügt über ein breiteres Angebot und ein engeres Netz als wir. Unser Anspruch ist es, jeden Tag frische und hochwertige Produkte bereitzustellen. Unsere Erfahrung und das gesammelte Know-how sorgen jederzeit für ein top Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis, überlegene Logistik und marktfrische Produkte. Wir verpflichten uns zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsumfeld, denn unser Erfolg beruht auf dem wertvollen Wissen der gut 1`900 Mitarbeitenden. Grundwerte wie Vertrauen, Loyalität, Herzlichkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein leben und fördern wir im Arbeitstag aktiv. Bei uns dürfen sich Mitarbeitende über attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen freuen. Jedes Jahr bilden wir gegen 100 Lernende zu Detailhandelsprofis aus und sind stolz darauf, dass weit über die Hälfte von Ihnen in unserer Unternehmung bleiben. Für unsere Leistungen im Human Resources Management wurden wir bereits mehrfach mit dem «Swiss Arbeitgeber Award» ausgezeichnet. Unser Hauptsitz befindet ich in Moosseedorf bei Bern. Die Transgourmet Schweiz ist ein Unternehmen der Transgourmet-Gruppe, welche zur Coop-Gruppe gehört und ihren Sitz in Basel hat. Die Transgourmet-Gruppe ist das zweitgrösste Unternehmen im europäischen Abhol- und Belieferungshandel und in Deutschland, Polen, Rumänien, Russland, Frankreich, Österreich und der Schweiz tätig.​

_crawl.linkedin_about: Supplybunny is a B2B food supply marketplace that helps restaurants, cafés, and retailers connect directly with trusted suppliers of premium ingredients and beverages. The platform simplifies procurement for SMEs that often struggle to meet the order sizes or account requirements of major distributors. By aggregating demand and streamlining operations, Supplybunny enables even the smallest F&B operators to access high-quality products from the same sources that serve established chains. The company specializes in supplying frozen beef and lamb, catering to Malaysia’s fast-growing foodservice industry that values consistency, freshness, and reliability. Beyond meats, Supplybunny is also the largest e-commerce partner for San Pellegrino and Aqua Panna, managing nationwide sales and distribution of these premium water brands. This partnership highlights Supplybunny’s capability to handle logistics at scale while maintaining the responsiveness and flexibility expected by small and medium F&B operators. Through its digital marketplace, restaurants can browse supplier catalogs, compare prices, and place bulk orders online—all while maintaining transparent visibility on delivery and stock status. When supplier disruptions occur, Supplybunny provides immediate alternatives, ensuring that businesses never face downtime due to missing ingredients. To support this, the company integrates real-time WhatsApp communication, allowing teams to coordinate deliveries, resolve order issues, and manage urgent requests instantly. Supplybunny’s value lies in its reliability and service. It bridges the gap between small buyers and large suppliers by combining the trust of established brands with the agility of modern technology. For suppliers, it opens new revenue channels without the administrative burden of managing small accounts; for restaurants, it means guaranteed access to quality ingredients when they need them most.

_crawl.linkedin_about: The Bulk Cart - Your Gateway to Sustainable B2B Trade Welcome to The Bulk Cart, where sustainable B2B trade meets purpose-driven e-commerce. We are a B2B marketplace with a global vision of greener B2B trade. Our mission is clear: to pave the path to a greener global future through sustainable B2B trade practices. Our vision At The Bulk Cart, we believe in the power of conscious choices. We envision a world where every B2B trade is an opportunity to empower sustainability. Our goal is to facilitate connections between manufacturers committed to sustainable practices and eco-conscious buyers worldwide. Trade with a Purpose: We understand that every choice matters. By partnering with The Bulk Cart, you are actively contributing to a more sustainable world with every B2B trade. We are your dedicated sustainable B2B partner in making a real impact. Elevate Your Business with Purpose: We are more than just a marketplace; we are a community of like-minded businesses focused on sustainability. Join our sustainability-driven B2B community and make a lasting, positive impact. Your Business, Our Planet Partner with The Bulk Cart for sustainable B2B solutions where sustainability meets success. Your business growth and profitability can align seamlessly with our commitment to a healthier planet. Join us in creating a world where sustainable choices lead to prosperous outcomes. Together, we can shape a greener, more responsible global future. Explore our Sustainability Hub and connect with eco-conscious vendors who share commitment to making the world a better place through trade with purpose.
